/.title: Lisbon Digital Nomads
/.description: We're a group of Nomads, Slowmads, Expats, and Locals who love to meet like-minded people and have a regular meetup running every Thursday since 2017!
h1: let's find your people in lisbon
h2: Hosting at amazing venues all over Lisbon
no business cards, no pitch, no agenda. just fun & friends
p: We organize our meetups at curated venues so our members can find their next favorite spot in the city. Are you a venue owner? Do you run a bar or space? Host us on a Thursday night and we'll bring you a Saturday-sized crowd&revenue!
We're not a business, but a community! We're all volunteers and these events are not for profit. Do you want to be part of our team?
A community of nomads, slowmads, expats and locals throwing the friendliest weekly meetup in the city. Come for the drinks, stay for the friendships.

Connect with other nomads during the rest of the week as well. Finding a new place to rent? Others to join you for a hike? Have questions about restaurants, visas, pet sitter, cleaning lady, language schools? This is your place to find answers and make new friends.
